title: English Practice Quiz 0988
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: A balanced diet includes ___.
questions.explanation: A balanced diet provides a range of nutrients.

questions.question: Regular physical activity can help ___.
questions.explanation: Physical activity supports physical and mental wellbeing.

questions.question: If someone feels dizzy, a sensible first step is to ___.
questions.explanation: Getting into a safe position can help prevent a fall.

questions.question: Adequate sleep is important for ___.
questions.explanation: Sleep supports recovery, memory and attention.

questions.question: A 'dehydrated' person has ___.
options: lost more body fluid than they have taken in
questions.explanation: Dehydration occurs when the body lacks sufficient fluid.

questions.question: Which habit supports good hand hygiene?
options: washing hands with soap and water
questions.explanation: Soap and water remove dirt and many germs.

questions.question: A routine health check is intended to ___.
questions.explanation: Checks can help identify issues that need follow-up.

questions.question: When using medicine, you should follow ___.
options: the directions provided by a qualified professional or label
questions.explanation: Medicine should be used according to appropriate instructions.

questions.question: A 'sedentary' lifestyle involves ___.
options: a lot of sitting and little movement
questions.explanation: Sedentary describes a lifestyle with little physical activity.

questions.question: If a health problem is severe or sudden, seek ___.
questions.explanation: Severe or sudden symptoms need prompt professional assessment.
